items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWEE] Me, Harold. So I was dancing.

ctx.x: But them little boys play. Suddenly, I'm telling you, they was playing. And I just couldn't sit still. I was cutting steps to old lady. Dance how much stuff she fell sitting down.
Me, Harold. So I was dancing. Carol and Codes and Mike Boxer and Amherst Space and I'd trip on them.
I was just sitting. We keep still. Did you feel good, huh? Yeah, they play some good. Mm-hm. I think they played for the Holy Family, son. They did. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
